chain.title: Step into the Sky
chain.desc: Activate a glowstone portal with water and enter the Aether. Bring supplies and mark the return portal before crossing the floating islands.

chain.title: A Workshop Above the Clouds
chain.desc: Gather Skyroot logs for your first Aether tools and workstations. Build bridges carefully; falling from the islands is a real hazard.

chain.title: Tools for Aether Stone
chain.desc: Progress through Skyroot tools to a Holystone Pickaxe. Local materials let you establish a mining route without relying on Overworld equipment behavior.

chain.title: Light and Altar Fuel
chain.desc: Mine Ambrosium and reserve some for your Altar. It supports both lighting and the enchanting workflow ahead.

chain.title: An Altar for Your Gear
chain.desc: Build an Altar and supply Ambrosium. Its recipes enchant materials and repair eligible items; check the displayed recipe before spending your shards.

chain.title: The Next Mining Tier
chain.desc: Mine Zanite to improve tools and armor. Split this supply between a stronger pickaxe and the equipment you want for dungeon expeditions.

chain.title: Reach the Floating Ore
chain.desc: Craft a Zanite Pickaxe for the next mining stage. Keep a spare tool for the Slider, which is fought with mining tools rather than ordinary sword damage.

chain.title: Prepare for a Dungeon
chain.desc: Make a Zanite Chestplate and prepare healing supplies. This is an equipment branch, not a demand to clear every dungeon in one fixed order.

chain.title: Ore That Defies Gravity
chain.desc: Locate Gravitite Ore and recover it for the Altar. Plan your footing and overhead clearance while mining the Aether's floating materials.

chain.title: Refine the Sky's Best Metal
chain.desc: Enchant Gravitite Ore in a fueled Altar. The enchanted material is used for the Gravitite equipment branch.

chain.title: Ready for Greater Challenges
chain.desc: Craft a Gravitite Chestplate and finish the rest of your chosen equipment. Better gear helps in all three dungeon routes.

chain.title: The Bronze Dungeon
chain.desc: Find a Bronze Dungeon and defeat the Slider with suitable mining tools. Watch its movement and keep clear of the arena walls during its charges.

chain.title: Open the Bronze Reward
chain.desc: Recover the Bronze Dungeon Key and use it on that dungeon's reward chest. Chest contents vary; a particular rare drop is not required here.

chain.title: Earn the Valkyries' Respect
chain.desc: Challenge Valkyries in a Silver Dungeon and collect their Victory Medals. Present the required medals before challenging the Valkyrie Queen.

chain.title: The Silver Throne
chain.desc: Challenge and defeat the Valkyrie Queen after earning her audience. Bring reliable armor and room to dodge her attacks.

chain.title: Claim the Silver Treasure
chain.desc: Use the Silver Dungeon Key on the reward chest after the Queen's defeat. This is a separate expedition from the Bronze Dungeon route.

chain.title: The Gold Dungeon
chain.desc: Find a Gold Dungeon and challenge the Sun Spirit. The encounter relies on returning the special icy projectile; ordinary attacks are not the solution.

chain.title: Treasure at Sunset
chain.desc: Collect the Gold Dungeon Key and unlock the reward chest. Return home with the reward from the Aether's highest dungeon challenge.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Sky survival, independent dungeon challenges, enchanted gravitite and dungeon keys.
coverage.limitations: Recipe quantities, enabled content and progression settings may be changed by the installed pack.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
